description: Every bookable treatment with its id (needed for check_availability and request_booking), category, minutes, price in USD before the service charge, and whether it is for couples. Categories: massage, couples, facial, body, nails, waxing, package, add-on, facility, other. Couples treatments are massages, so they are also returned under "massage". With for_couples true, the category only narrows the list when something matches; otherwise all couples treatments are returned. Add-ons are listed too but are not booked on their own.

category.description: Only this category ("massage" includes couples massages)

for_couples.description: true: only treatments for two; false: only for one

max_price_usd.description: Only treatments at or under this price

name: list_services
title: List treatments and prices
